## Contract review
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER
Head-sha: `a9fdb19a1d96384437ce0769957456c76c48f806`
Implemented-by: os-dev subagent of session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd
Reviewed-by: independent reviewer subagent of session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd
Local-runs: probe — partitioner and nightly-tiers self-tests plus coupling probes at a9fdb19a1d in the card's worktree, tree restored clean (detail below)

Probe detail: in /home/claude/objectstack-issue-28580 at a9fdb19a1d (`git fetch -q origin main`; merge base cd065d3698, origin/main now d94dd3a65d = 2 commits ahead, none touching the three files): `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test` exit 0; `node scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --self-test` exit 0 (48 cases); `node scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --packages` + `partition-test-shards.mjs --shard k/4` for k=1..4 (prints `@objectstack/cli 1/3`, `2/3`, `3/3`, `@objectstack/example-showcase`; stderr `own shard: ... alone on shard 4/4`), `--shard 1/1` (refused: "reserves 1 shard(s) of a 1-shard run"), `--shard k/2` (CLI whole on 1, showcase on 2). Coupling probes with the tree edited and restored via `git checkout` (tree clean afterwards): matrix `[1,2,3]` with `--shard k/4` kept → partition self-test RED; matrix `[1,2,3]` + `--shard k/3` → green (document re-slices itself); preparation step grepping `@objectstack/example-crm` → RED naming both sides; preparation step deleted → RED ("prepares []"); `OWN_SHARD_PACKAGES = []` → partition self-test RED (nightly-tiers' own self-test stays green, by design, since the live pin lives in the partitioner). GitHub reads only: issue #28580 + 3 comments, PR #28613 body, check-runs on the head, jobs/steps and logs of nightly runs 41277375892 (11-01), 41009107101 (10-30), 41173036489 (10-31), 40824087205, 40638682260, and the PR's own run 41286811251 (job 124789667673 log). Nothing written anywhere.

### Findings

1. **note — the measurements the diff rests on are true to the logs.** Run 41277375892 shard 1 (job 124762188633): setup→Compute 05:33:12→05:34:04 = 0m52s; Prepare 05:34:04→05:43:43 = 9m39s (turbo `Cached: 2 cached, 72 total`, 9m18s); CLI 1/2 leg `Time: 33m11.782s`, `Cached: 0 cached, 63 total`, vitest `Duration 1631.44s`, 43 files, `tests 4661.24s`; cancelled 06:18:39, 1m43s after the CLI leg ended. Shard 2: leg 24m31s, vitest 1127.38s, 42 files, `tests 3320.13s`, job 25m19s. Run 41009107101 shard 1 showcase leg `Time: 8m14.051s` with vitest 160.45s. All match the header (.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml:38-50) and `OWN_SHARD_PACKAGES`' comment (scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs:226-238). The "builds do not replay" claim (yml:23-26) holds on every night I read (`Cached: 0 cached, 63 total`) and on the PR's own shard 4 (`0 cached, 66 total`). 43+42 = 85 files vs the PR's 86: one `packages/cli/test/build-connector-spec-file-artifact.e2e.test.ts` landed on main between 890c2a6d and the branch point — reconciled.

2. **note — real-runner reading, three of four shards in at hand-back.** PR run 41286811251 (`pull_request`, head a9fdb19a1d): **shard 4/4 (showcase alone)** test step 07:58:19→08:04:40 = 6m21s, job 7m23s, Prepare only 19s (`pnpm console:build` replayed 71/72 from main's restored cache this time). **Shard 3/4 (CLI 3/3)** test step 07:57:59→08:08:40 = 10m41s, success, job ≈ 11m20s against the predicted ≈ 18 min. **Shard 2/4 (CLI 2/3)** success, job ≈ 16 min (07:57:19→≈08:13:36) against the predicted ≈ 22 min. **Shard 1/4 (CLI 1/3, the predicted slowest at ≈ 29 min)** was still in its test step when I handed back; the approver should read its final `Run this shard's nightly tiers` duration. Every completed shard came in under its prediction, so the budget fit is on track; the 45-minute limit is not in view.

3. **note — shard 4 of the PR run is red on a real Console live spec, not on the layout.** `test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` → Playwright `e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts:44` "the member browser attempted no write" (1 of 19 failed); `test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` passed; completeness guard `OK (1 of 1 scheduled package(s) reported ... 2 test(s) declared and all accounted for)`. This is the same showcase-red class seen on 10-30 and is a product failure outside this card's file surface (triage: shard placement / budget only). It does not weaken the PR, but the next main nightly will stay red on it and the card's "fix what it names" rule means someone owns it next — worth saying in the approval so the red is not read as this PR's.

4. **should-fix — two comments in the governed workflow still say "both shards".** .github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml:71 ("ONE writer, after both shards") and :175-176 ("Both shards run to completion"). With `shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]` at :179 the self-description is false in wording (the lane note: 门禁的自述必须为真). One-word fixes ("all shards").

5. **should-fix — scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs header heading and first paragraph contradict the new design.** :70 "## The nightly's shards: one slice of the tier on EVERY shard" and :73-75 "the one tier-owning package (`@objectstack/cli`, 82 tier files at 4f81f31526) has to reach every one of the nightly's shards as a slice" — after this PR shard 4 carries no CLI slice, two packages own tier files (86 + 2), and the same header's later paragraph (:88-101, edited by the PR) says so correctly. The stale "one tier-owning package" predates the PR, but the heading now states the opposite of what the diff does.

6. **should-fix (minor, pre-existing but on a line the PR edits) — the balance line miscounts slices.** scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs:3864-3866 prints `${weighted.length - packages} of them file-level slices of ${packages} package(s)`; at 4 shards that is `(2 of them file-level slices of 2 package(s))` for three slices (live output above). The PR acknowledges it in "Acceptance notes" and leaves it; since the same `console.error` was touched to add "over the N shared shard(s)", counting `weighted.filter(w => w.slice).length` would make the one log line a reader trusts true at no extra surface.

7. **note — the `ownShard` partitioner change is correct as far as I can break it.** `readOwnShard` (:1684-1720) refuses non-array / non-string / empty / duplicate / unlisted / also-sliced names and `names.length >= shardCount` (empty list allowed); `planRun` (:1760-1795) plans everything else over `shardCount − k`, filters reserved packages out of `weighed`, excludes them from the density cap, re-adds them as whole items with the same shape `expandSlices` emits for a whole package (`{name, weight, pkg, slice: null, tasks}` — :746 vs :1790), and refuses a reserved package that is excluded or under `ui/` ("would run nothing"). `assertSlicesSpread` runs over placed + reserved bins, so no slice is dropped or duplicated and bins.length === shardCount for `main()`'s `bins[shardIndex-1]`. The new battery's 12 cases and the three live pins are real: my probes above red exactly the couplings they claim to pin (matrix↔`--shard k/N`, preparation step↔`OWN_SHARD_PACKAGES`), and the roster floor rose 17→18 with per-battery minimums.

8. **note — workflow consistency.** The shard count appears in exactly four places (:167 job name `/4`, :179 matrix, :225 `--shard k/4`, :352 artifact `-of-4`) and all agree; the header now says four places (:61-62) where it said three. The report job reads `pattern: nightly-tiers-reports-*` with `merge-multiple` (:421-423) and the card groups tails by `shard-N` directory, so neither is count-bound; `check-test-completeness.mjs --scheduled` parses the `k/n` grammar (passed on the PR's shard 4). `fail-fast: false` kept. The only other `/2` spelling in the repo is a fixture in scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs:1627, not a live reference. Nothing narrows which tier files run: `OS_TEST_TIERS: nightly` unchanged (:280), `nightly-tiers.mjs --check/--packages` unchanged, the 86 CLI files reach three slices and the 2 showcase files run whole; no test renamed, skipped or deleted (diff touches only the three listed files).

### Verdict
**PASS** — no must-fix. The remedy is placement only, honours 「⛔ never by narrowing or skipping tiers」, its numbers are true to the logs, and the self-tests fail when the couplings break. Conditions for the approver: read shard 1/4 of run 41286811251 when it finishes (predicted ≈ 29 min; shards 2/4, 3/4 finished green and under prediction), and treat shard 4's red as the pre-existing Console live-spec failure, not this diff. Findings 4–6 are wording/log-line truth fixes that can ride the same PR or a follow-up.

## Contract review

Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs <nightly --packages json> --shard 1/4` at a908869297 (worktree checked out detached to that sha and returned to the branch, tree clean), to read the corrected balance line.

Delta reviewed: one commit a908869297 on top of a9fdb19a1d (`git diff a9fdb19a1d..origin/claude/issue-28580-nightly-shard-budget`), 3 files, 9 lines: the two "both shards" comments, the nightly-tiers.mjs header heading/paragraph, and the slice count in the partitioner's balance line. Same reviewer as the full record on a9fdb19a1d above; every finding there stands except those closed here.

### Findings

1. **resolved (was should-fix 4) — .github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml:71 and :175** now read "after all shards" and "All shards run to completion". Comment-only change on the governed file; no step, matrix, name, `--shard k/4` or artifact `-of-4` touched (the only two hunks in the file are those comment lines).

2. **resolved (was should-fix 5) — scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs:70-77** heading is now "every shard runs something, by the nightly's own count" and the paragraph states two tier-owning packages: the CLI "86 tier files at cd065d3698", sliced, and the showcase whole on its own shard. The 86 is true: `git ls-files packages/cli | grep -E '\.(e2e|live)\.test\.'` = 86 at the branch point cd065d3698. The historical paragraph below (:79-88) stays correct as history.

3. **resolved (was should-fix 6) — scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs:3866** now counts `weighted.filter((w) => w.slice).length`. Correct against the item shapes: slices carry `slice: {index, count}` (expandSlices :755), whole items and reserved entries carry `slice: null` (:746, :1790). Probe output at the new head: `shard 1/4: 1/4 items (3 of them file-level slices of 2 package(s)), 899.1s predicted …` — was `2 of them`. Stderr only; the shard's stdout package list is unchanged.

4. **note — CI on the new head.** `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` (runs `partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`), `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are green on a908869297. The delta changes no shard behaviour.

5. **closed — the real-runner reading is complete and inside the budget.** Run 41286811251 (head a9fdb19a1d, the same layout): shard 1/4 (CLI 1/3) success, test step 07:58:13→08:26:21 = 28m08s; 2/4 success, 15m29s; 3/4 success, 10m41s; 4/4 red in 6m21s on the pre-existing Console live spec `e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts` ("the member browser attempted no write"; filed #28618), with `test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` passing and the completeness guard OK. Slowest shard ≈ 29 min against the 45-minute limit.

### Verdict
**PASS** — the delta is exactly the three wording/log-line truth fixes asked for, each verified against the tree and (for the log line) by running it. It changes no shard behaviour, and the PR's own four-shard run finished with its slowest shard at ≈ 29 min.

- **先看**:① `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml` 的矩阵 `[1, 2, 3, 4]`,以及分片数出现的 4 处;② `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` 的 `readOwnShard` / `planRun`;③ `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs` 的 `OWN_SHARD_PACKAGES`。

**席位意见**:建议批准。这次只调整放置方式,没有收窄任何层级。实测与预测一致(最慢的分片预测约 29 分钟,实测 28 分钟),而且分片数和 workflow 是互相钉住的:改其中一边、不改另一边,自测会变红。落地只等 #28618。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:devx#2` · head `a908869297b6f291d557075b2fbbad653ed72e62` · 2026-11-01T08:30Z

Checked against GitHub and the PR head, not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** a draft PR to `main` with `Fixes #28580` once, plus `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. It has no assignees. `skip-changeset` is correct, because only `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml`, `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs` and `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` change and no package is published. `check-governed-merges --pr 28613` reports it as GOVERNED (the workflow path), with 472 lines (+376/−96), under the 3000-line threshold. It is Tier H and waits on a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval.
- **Premise measured:** the card's red is shard 1 of run 41277375892, cancelled at 45 minutes with no test failing. The PR's own run 41286811251 on the same layout finished its test steps in 28m08s (1/4, CLI 1/3), 15m29s (2/4), 10m41s (3/4) and 6m21s (4/4, showcase alone). The slowest shard has about 16 minutes of headroom, matching the header's prediction. No tier is narrowed: `OS_TEST_TIERS: nightly` is unchanged, the same 86 CLI files reach three slices, and the 2 showcase files run whole.
- **Gates:** every check-run on this head is green or skipped, except `Nightly tiers (4/4)`. That job failed on `e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts` ("the member browser attempted no write", 1 of 19 specs). The showcase smoke passed and the completeness guard reported OK. The spec counts the record page's read `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/page` as a write. It never ran on `main`, because shard 1 was killed before the showcase leg started, so there is no base signature to match. It is filed as #28618, and this PR does not queue until #28618 lands and 4/4 is green. The red-card job is gated to `refs/heads/main`, so the PR runs touch no card. Run 41287799213 on this head is in progress.
- **Review:** the full contract-tier review on `a9fdb19a1d` (6555543054) PASSed with no must-fix and three should-fixes. All three were taken in `a908869297` (comments and log text only). The same reviewer's delta review on this head (6555548336) PASSed.
- **Accepted deviations:** none against the triage scope (placement or budget only). The PR body predates the delta. Its "Pre-existing and left alone" note about the balance line is superseded, because `a908869297` fixes the count.
- **Out of scope:** the PR body records three findings without filing them: CLI e2e per-file time grew 43% between 10-26 and 11-01; the CLI legs replay 0 of their build tasks from the Build Core cache; and vitest's `--shard` cuts by file count. Each is an observation that needs no card while the budget holds. The re-shard trigger (the slowest test step nearing 35 minutes) is written in the workflow header. `Skills-docs: none — CI shard layout only, no metadata surface`.
- **Landing:** Tier H. This needs an approval from an authorized approver and #28618 landed with 4/4 green, then the seat runs the pre-landing checks, clears `needs-user-decision`, and queues the PR.
